reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Connecticut
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Is "mail" a primary method of service for eviction actions?

    Source statute encoded (as provided):
    - CT Gen Stat  52-57 (2020)
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(connecticut).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_action_kind(eviction).          % eviction action (a civil action type for this QA)
scenario_method_in_question(mail).       % "mail" as a method of service (plain mailing to defendant)

% Helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario is fully specified.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(connecticut),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_action_kind(eviction),
    scenario_method_in_question(mail).

% -----------------------------
% Statute applicability
% -----------------------------

% CT Gen Stat  52-57 (2020) applies in 2021 (and beyond), for purposes of this QA.
statute_ct_52_57_applies_in_year(Year) :-
    integer(Year),
    Year >= 2020.

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations (CT Gen Stat  52-57)
% -----------------------------

/*
  CT Gen Stat  52-57(a) (2020):
  "process in any civil action shall be served by leaving a true and attested copy of it ...
   with the defendant, or at his usual place of abode, in this state."
  We model these as PRIMARY methods for civil actions generally, unless another provision applies.
*/

% statute_ct_52_57_primary_method_for_civil_action(Method).
statute_ct_52_57_primary_method_for_civil_action(personal_delivery_to_defendant).
statute_ct_52_57_primary_method_for_civil_action(leaving_at_usual_place_of_abode_in_state).

/*
  CT Gen Stat  52-57(d) (2020): partnerships
  - If no partners are residents of CT, service may be made upon the Secretary of the State;
    provided the officer shall mail copies (registered/certified, return receipt requested)
    to partners not personally served.
  We model: "mailing" here as a REQUIRED SUPPLEMENTARY STEP, not itself the service method.
*/

% statute_ct_52_57_partnership_substituted_service_requires_mailing(true).
statute_ct_52_57_partnership_substituted_service_requires_mailing(true).

/*
  CT Gen Stat  52-57(e) (2020): voluntary associations
  - When served on the Secretary of the State, the officer must also send a copy by
    registered/certified mail to the defendant's last-known address.
  Again: mailing is supplementary to the service on the Secretary of the State.
*/

% statute_ct_52_57_voluntary_association_substituted_service_requires_mailing(true).
statute_ct_52_57_voluntary_association_substituted_service_requires_mailing(true).

/*
  CT Gen Stat  52-57(f) (2020): child support-related actions
  - When other methods of service cannot be effected, service may be made by:
    (1) certified mail to employer (with special envelope marking), OR
    (2) personal service on employer's designated agent (15+ employees),
    provided proof of receipt is presented to the court per rules.
  These are SECONDARY/ALTERNATIVE methods available only after failure of other methods.
*/

% statute_ct_52_57f_secondary_method_for_child_support(Method).
statute_ct_52_57f_secondary_method_for_child_support(certified_mail_to_employer).
statute_ct_52_57f_secondary_method_for_child_support(personal_service_on_employer_designated_agent).

% Condition trigger for 52-57(f): other methods cannot be effected.
statute_ct_52_57f_requires_other_methods_cannot_be_effected(true).

% -----------------------------
% Legal classification helpers
% -----------------------------

% Treat eviction as a civil action for purposes of 52-57(a).
action_is_civil(eviction).
action_is_civil(child_support).  % also a civil action, but has special rule in 52-57(f)

% Identify action kinds covered by 52-57(f).
action_is_child_support_related(child_support).

% -----------------------------
% Primary vs secondary method framework for this QA
% -----------------------------

/*
  Primary methods (as defined in the question): methods that must be attempted before a
  secondary method is permitted.

  For CT under the provided statute set:
  - For general civil actions, 52-57(a) provides primary methods: personal delivery or abode.
  - Mailing appears in the statute only as:
      (i) a supplementary requirement for certain substituted services (partnership/association),
          not itself a standalone "method of service"; and
     (ii) a secondary method in child support actions when other methods cannot be effected (52-57(f)).
*/

% legal_primary_method_of_service(State, Year, ActionKind, Method).
legal_primary_method_of_service(connecticut, Year, ActionKind, Method) :-
    statute_ct_52_57_applies_in_year(Year),
    action_is_civil(ActionKind),
    \+ action_is_child_support_related(ActionKind),  % eviction is not child support
    statute_ct_52_57_primary_method_for_civil_action(Method).

% For child support actions, the statute still has the general primary methods in 52-57(a).
legal_primary_method_of_service(connecticut, Year, ActionKind, Method) :-
    statute_ct_52_57_applies_in_year(Year),
    action_is_child_support_related(ActionKind),
    statute_ct_52_57_primary_method_for_civil_action(Method).

% legal_secondary_method_of_service(State, Year, ActionKind, Method).
legal_secondary_method_of_service(connecticut, Year, ActionKind, Method) :-
    statute_ct_52_57_applies_in_year(Year),
    action_is_child_support_related(ActionKind),
    statute_ct_52_57f_secondary_method_for_child_support(Method),
    statute_ct_52_57f_requires_other_methods_cannot_be_effected(true).

% A helper to recognize "mail" (plain mailing to the defendant) as asked in the question.
% (This is NOT the same as the specialized 52-57(f)(1) certified-mail-to-employer method.)
method_is_plain_mail_to_defendant(mail).

% -----------------------------
% Question application
% -----------------------------

% Determine whether the questioned method is a primary method for the scenario's action.
scenario_method_is_primary(Method) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_action_kind(ActionKind),
    legal_primary_method_of_service(State, Year, ActionKind, Method).

% Core QA: "Is mail a primary method of service for eviction actions?"
% We interpret "mail" as plain mailing to the defendant (not 52-57(f) certified mail to employer).
mail_is_primary_for_eviction_in_scenario :-
    method_is_plain_mail_to_defendant(Method),
    scenario_method_is_primary(Method).

% -----------------------------
% Required output predicate
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    mail_is_primary_for_eviction_in_scenario,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (required)
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Primary methods of service are defined as those methods that must be attempted before a secondary method is permitted. Is mail a primary method of service for eviction actions?
